notes.title: Important NEWS!!!
notes.content:
Dear my friends,

After I see the many negative reviews and people doesn't read the description, I've decided I will release Chapter 2 and next Chapters only on my Patreon site (patreon.com/sinsmith). 
The main reason of my decision, I can create/work, if I don't read these negative comments. I don't want that if these people would affect my job. I always appreciate the helpful suggestions/wishes etc....but not hate behavior.

Chapter 2 will releases in February with:
- 2 new species
- 6 new sexual poses
- New maps

Follow me on Patreon!

Thank you for your understanding!

Bests,
Steve
